description: Embeddable R7RS Scheme for Go: hygienic macros, first-class continuations, a full numeric tower, and a capability sandbox. Pure Go, no CGo.
rules: A wile.Engine is not safe for concurrent use; give each goroutine its own Engine or synchronize externally.
Engine.Parse accepts exactly one expression and rejects trailing input; use Engine.EvalMultiple to evaluate several.
(import (scheme base)) needs WithProfile(wile.Small) or larger AND WithSourceFS(wile.StdLibFS) plus WithLibraryPaths("lib"). The Tiny profile cannot load it.
Phase-shifted imports are written (for-syntax (scheme base)), not the R6RS form (for (scheme base) expand).
